# Andile Khumalo

> Freelance full-stack developer based in Cape Town, South Africa, specializing in .NET and React. Available for freelance and contract work alongside a full-time software developer role.

## Background

- Full-time Software Developer at Advania SA (June 2024–present); previously Clickatell (2023–2024) and Bull Tech Services (2022–2023).
- National Diploma in Information Technology, Mangosuthu University of Technology (2022).
- Core stack: C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Azure, Docker.
- Services: full stack web development, API design & integration, cloud deployment & architecture, legacy system modernization, performance optimization.
